description: A literal or an arithmetic or boolean expression as a CALL USING argument (BY CONTENT or keyword-less) - a COBOL-2002 introduction, QUOTED from ISO/IEC 1989:2002 Annex F.2 item 15: "CALL statement. Arithmetic expressions and literals may be used as arguments of the CALL statement." In 2002 and later they belong to the program-prototype CALL only (2002 §2023:14.8.4.1 Format 3; 2023 §2023:14.9.4.2 Format 2). Gated in ONE place, CallBinder.Format1Narrowing, with OMITTED and BY VALUE (kb/Work PB4503): below 2002 a Format 1 CALL argument so spelled is this COBOL0900, and under --permissive the vendor extension (owner decision 2026-11-03). VCR row 7.47 (item 15).
display: a literal or expression as a CALL argument
